title: IATF wɛbsaet
summary: International Accessibility Task Force wɛbsaet no wɔ hɔ ma ɔmanfo.
problem: Ná IATF hia ɔmanfo fie a emu yɛ den a ɛkyerɛkyerɛ mfatoho no mu, kyerɛw nnwuma no din, na ɛkyerɛ wɔn a wɔyɛ adwuma no kwan ma wɔfa ɔkwampa a edi hɔ no so.
why: Saa wɛbsaet yi yɛ IATF no pon a edi hɔ ma ɔmanfo. Wosii no sɛ ɔfã ketewa bi a ɛwɔ hɔ ma enti ɛyɛ mmerɛw sɛ wobɛkenkan, wobɛkyerɛ ase, na woahwɛ so wɔ baabi a abue.
scopeIn: Aban nkratafa a ɛkyerɛkyerɛ IATF mfoni no mu
IATF nhyehyɛɛ ahorow a wɔagye ato mu, wɔn a wɔyɛ edwuma, na wɔakora so ho dawurubɔ a wɔn tebea, wɔn hwɛfo, wɔn korabea, ne wɔn adansedie wɔ mu
Krataafa a wɔfa so gye nkrataa ne fomu
Krataa a ɛwɔ Borɔfo kasa mu a wɔasiesie no yiye a wobetumi akyerɛ ase
Static deployment wɔ Cloudflare Adwumayɛfo Static Asset
scopeOut: Nnipakuw a wɔn ani da wɔn ho so, nkrataa, anaa wɔn a wɔde wɔn ho hyem
Dwumadi no nnyinaso code, a ɛwɔ dwumadie no ankasa akorae no mu
Real-time nkɔmmɔbɔ, a ɛwɔ Discord mu
Nsɛnnennen a wɔdi akyi wɔ dwumadie biara mu, a ɛwɔ dwumadie biara GitHub akoraeɛ mu

title: IATF Selfie
summary: IATF mfitiase mfatoho, a wɔakora so wɔ bere a wɔadu baabi a ɛsɛ sɛ wogyina.
problem: Nhyehyɛe a edi kan a wɔfa so yɛ nnwinnade a wɔde di dwuma wɔ IATF mu.
why: Wɔkora akoraeɛ no so ma ɔmanfo sɛ adwuma no ho kyerɛwtohɔ, ɛmfa ho sɛ wɔayɛ adwuma no ato hɔ.
scopeIn: Nhyehyɛe a edi kan a wɔde di dwuma ma wɔn a wɔn nsa ka nsɛm no a wɔde kɔ baguam no
scopeOut: Nhyehyɛɛ a ɛreyɛ adwuma anaa adwuma a ɛrekɔ so
Ade a wɔhyɛ ho nkuran sɛ wɔde di dwuma wɔ nnwumakuw mu
